name: 07093 · West New York, NJ
findings: ZIP 07093 (West New York) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07093 (West New York) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07093 (West New York) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).
